patch_description: This redesign separates graph sanitation, broadcast planning, exact Steiner-tree optimization, reconstruction, and topology materialization into dedicated components. The planner uses a directed Steiner dynamic program for small-to-medium destination sets, which finds a minimum shared-edge broadcast tree rather than relying on greedy attachment order. For larger terminal sets, it falls back to a marginal-cost shared-tree heuristic to retain practical runtime. Shared tree prefixes are emitted identically for every partition, allowing downstream scheduling to transfer each partition once and fan it out across destinations.
